title: The Crowbell Boss Guide: Three-Arena Chase and the Book of Specialisation
summary: Path of Exile 2 Act 1 Hunting Grounds optional boss guide: the three-arena chase, the Bell pickup, and the Book of Specialisation for +2 Weapon Set Passive Points.
description: Beat The Crowbell in the Hunting Grounds (Act 1). Follow the dead-animal path, survive the chase, grab the Bell, and claim the Book of Specialisation for +2 Weapon Set Passive Points.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

sections.title: Remember These First
sections.callout: The Crowbell is an Act 1 Hunting Grounds optional boss fought as a three-arena CHASE — one boss, one health bar, not three separate bosses.
calloutDetail: He flees after the first pillar-top fight — that is INTENDED, not a bug. Follow the route; do not wait at the old arena.
Follow the dead-animal corpses — they are the path hints (added as environmental cues in 0.5.0).
The Book of Specialisation drops on the ground after the final kill; pick it up AND right-click it for +2 Weapon Set Passive Points.

items.question: How do I find The Crowbell in the Hunting Grounds?
answer: Progress the Trail of Corruption quest into the Hunting Grounds. Follow the slaughtered-cattle corpses (0.5.0 environmental cue) to the gate, then the linear path to the dead-end 'Hunt Stone' arena.

items.question: Why did the boss run away?
answer: After the first pillar-top fight he flees to the next arena — this is intended. Follow the route; the fight does NOT require reopening the map.

items.question: What changes after I pick up the Bell?
answer: He grabs the Bell and breaks a wooden gate, then uses Bell Slam and a Spinning Bell Swing in the final arena. Stay back from the cracks and corners.

items.question: Why didn't I get Passive Points?
answer: The Book of Specialisation drops on the ground and must be picked up AND right-clicked. The +2 are Weapon Set Passive Points (Weapon Set node), not your normal pool.

steps.label: Trail of Corruption
body: From Clearfell Encampment through the Cemetery to the Hunting Grounds (mandatory story path).

steps.label: Follow the dead animals
body: Slaughtered cattle mark the path since 0.5.0; follow them to the gate and the linear dead-end arena.

steps.label: Start the fight
body: At the 'Hunt Stone' the Crowbell perches on a pillar, roars, and leaps down to fight.

sections.title: Encounter Overview
paragraphs: The Crowbell is a single boss fought across three connected arenas as a continuous chase. There is one health bar — the flee is a scripted phase of the same encounter, not three bosses and not a bug.
The threat comes from tight arenas and a few one-shot melee hits, not mechanical complexity. Patience and dodging beat trying to brute-force him.
bullets: One boss, one HP bar, three-arena chase.
The flee is intended — follow the route.
The Book of Specialisation is the reward.

sections.title: Encounter Loop — Three Arenas
paragraphs: Arena 1 (Hunt Stone / pillar top): the open start. After ~10-25% HP lost he flees. Arena 2 (between two gates): the tightest, hardest space. After a ground-punch sequence he grabs the Bell, breaks a gate, and flees to Arena 3 (thorn-vine enclosure) for the final fight.
The whole chase happens in the same map instance — it does NOT require reopening the map or re-entering the zone.
bullets: Bell -> breaks gate -> final vine arena.
Same instance; no map reset needed.

phases.label: Phase 1 — Continuous Chase (3 Arenas)
phases.trigger: Fight starts at the Hunt Stone.
notes: One HP bar across three arenas. The flee and Bell transitions are scripted, not separate bosses.

attacks.name: Ground Pound / Leaping Slam
telegraph: Leaps to your location and slams, small AoE shockwave.
responses: Dodge to the side on landing.

attacks.name: Pummel (ground-punch)
telegraph: Roars and repeats ground punches (~40-50% HP, pre-Bell).

attacks.name: Bell Slam (post-Bell)
telegraph: Lifts the Bell, slams it, shockwave/cracks toward you.
responses: Back up and dodge the cracks.

attacks.name: Spinning Bell Swing
telegraph: Builds momentum, spins twice with the Bell, knockback.
responses: Retreat to a corner / out of range.
notes: Can drain HP fast for squishy ranged; comes back-to-back near 25% HP.

sections.title: Reward Claim Flow — Book of Specialisation to +2 Weapon Set Passives
paragraphs: After the final kill in the vine arena, the Book of Specialisation drops on the ground. Pick it up — it is a one-time drop.
Right-click the Book in inventory. It grants +2 Weapon Set Passive Skill Points, allocated in the Weapon Set node of the passive tree — not your normal Passive Point pool.
bullets: Pillar top -> chase -> Bell -> final arena.
Pick it up AND right-click -> +2 Weapon Set Passive Points.
One-time; shown in the Weapon Set node.

sections.title: Build Considerations
paragraphs: The Crowbell is a positioning fight in cramped spaces. The Spinning Bell Swing and Bell Slam punish melee that over-commits; ranged must respect the back-to-back swings near 25% HP.
Because it is one continuous chase, keep your flask and mobility ready between arenas. Do not blow cooldowns during the flee — save them for the final vine arena.
bullets: Melee: back off during Bell attacks.
Save burst for the final arena.

entries.question: Crowbell becomes invulnerable / can't finish
summary: Bug reports of the boss going invulnerable at low HP before grabbing the Bell, blocking the kill and reward.
editorialAnalysis: If the transition fails he cannot be finished. This is a bug, distinct from the intended flee. Restart the instance if stuck.
officialAnswer: The flee is intended; if he is truly invulnerable, reset the instance.

entries.question: Crowbell reward broken when I had unspent points
summary: After right-clicking the Book the 2 points 'weren't accounted for' and the Book disappeared.
editorialAnalysis: The +2 are Weapon Set Passive Points in the Weapon Set node, not the normal pool — players often look in the wrong place.
officialAnswer: The Book grants +2 Weapon Set Passive Points, allocated in the passive tree Weapon Set node.

problems.symptom: The boss ran away and I lost him
directAnswer: That is intended — follow the route through the gate to the next arena. The fight does not need a map reset. Only if he is truly invulnerable should you reset the instance.
